title: Welcome to Flood-Net
summary: A first look, with Graham: the stations, the repeaters and the radio paths between them, in one place — and where to start.

scenes.title: Welcome to Flood-Net
scenes.line: The stations, the repeaters and the radio paths between them — in one place.
scenes.say: G'day. Graham Watts. I've looked after these gauges longer than most of them have been on the air. Let me show you round.

scenes.title: The network
scenes.say: These are the stations that measure the rain and the rivers, and the repeaters that relay their readings home by radio.
scenes.note: Counted from the station list this device has loaded.

scenes.title: On the map
scenes.say: Here they all are, from the coast to well past the range.

scenes.title: A station's card
scenes.say: Press a station and its card has the lot: its health, the site and its photos, the way in, and what relays it home.
points: When it was last heard, and its battery
The site, its photos and the way in
What relays it, and the path home

scenes.title: How the network is
scenes.say: Every weekday morning the network checks itself. What needs a look comes first, with a short bulletin to watch over your coffee.
points: What needs a look, worst first
Stations gone quiet, batteries running down
A short bulletin, said by the crew

scenes.title: The radio side
scenes.sub: Paths, repeaters and what else is on the air
scenes.say: On the radio side: will a path work, where should a repeater go, and what else is on the air nearby.
points: Will a path work, and by how much
The best spots for a new repeater

scenes.title: Out in the field
scenes.say: And in the field, it's made for your phone: the inspection sheet keeps going with no signal, and your photos know where they were taken.
points: One inspection sheet, shaped to the station
Photos stamped with where and which way

scenes.title: That's the start of it
scenes.sub: The rest is on one page, a line each
scenes.say: That's the start of it. The rest is listed on one page, a line each, with short videos for the jobs you'll do most.
scenes.line: Might as well do it properly.
